description: This file manages systemd D-Bus connections, including connection initialization, retries, resetting, and handling disconnections, for the 'systemd' package.

classes.name: dbusConnManager
classes.description: Manages systemd D-Bus connections, including creation, retrieval, reset, and retry logic.

methods.name: newDbusConnManager
methods.description: Initializes a new systemd D-Bus connection manager, setting rootless mode.

methods.name: getConnection
methods.description: Lazily initializes and returns the systemd D-Bus connection, reusing existing connection if available.

methods.name: newConnection
methods.description: Creates a new systemd D-Bus connection with retries and exponential backoff.

methods.name: resetConnection
methods.description: Resets the current D-Bus connection, closing it and setting it to nil.

methods.name: retryOnDisconnect
methods.description: Retries an operation if the D-Bus connection is closed, re-establishing the connection as needed.
